comments.author: Li Yue
comments.body:
I'm not so sure increasing cannon capacity has any effect on ship speed. Just as I don't believe any mod that decreases cargo will improve it. The idea of it is you change how things are organized on the boat, but you aren't changing the actual dimensions of the boat.

Refitting the boat to accept maximum number of crew and cannons does end up decreasing your cargo, but that wouldn't speed the boat up any because overall hold size remains the same (crew+cannons+cargo).
